source.original_question: Find the height of the lighthouse to the nearest tenth of a metre.

adaptations.reason: Decorative scenery/icons removed; native mathematical lines, angle arcs, measurements and point relationships retained.

independent_solution.method: Top elevation=sqrt37²-27²=√640 and base elevation=sqrt34²-27²=√427. Lighthouseheight=√640-√427=4.6338..., rounds4.6m.
